procedural_matters: GBR 8762 was represented by Cassius Day.
ITA 7882 was represented by Samuele Bardelli.
Helena Lee Kangur (EST 9169) gave evidence as a witness.
Hannah Yates (GBR 6611) gave evidence as a witness.
facts: During RS Feva race F4 the conditions were 8 knots and smallwaves.
Both boats were sailing downwind on starboard tack.
GBR 8762 was 1m clear astern and one boat-width to leeward of ITA 7882.
ITA 7882 gybed onto port in front of GBR 8762.
GBR 8762 immediately gybed onto port and luffed.
After the gybe there was a lateral distance of 1 boat-widthbetween the boats.
There was no contact between the boats.
No boats took a penalty turn.
conclusions: ITA 7882 on port did not keep clear of GBR 8762 as starboardright-of-way boat and broke RRS 10.
decision: ITA 7882 is scored DSQ in race F4.
